Expected Salary: $35 – $40 per hour

Service Coordinator - Scheduling & Operations Focus
Part-time | Canberra-based | Customer & technician coordination

About us
We are a proudly local, family-owned electrical & technology services company in Canberra. We deliver end-to-end solutions across electrical, solar, security, air conditioning, and data.

Our reputation is built on reliability, communication, and getting jobs done properly the first time. We work across residential and commercial clients and maintain long-term relationships through consistent delivery.

We run a structured, systems-driven operation using Simpro for job management and simple SOPs to keep everything moving. As we grow, we need someone who can take ownership of the day-to-day coordination of jobs and keep the business flowing efficiently.

The role
This is a hands-on coordination role focused on scheduling, responsiveness, and keeping technicians productive.

You’ll be responsible for ensuring work is booked, planned, and executed efficiently while maintaining a high level of communication with customers.

1) Scheduling & workflow control
Own the daily schedule and ensure technicians are fully allocated
Book jobs and quote visits as soon as enquiries come in
Plan upcoming work to minimise downtime and maximise productivity
Confirm job details, access, materials, and notes ahead of each day
Adjust schedules in real time as priorities change
Ensure all jobs are kept moving and nothing sits idle

2) Customer communication
Manage inbound enquiries (phone, email, website) and respond promptly
Book new work quickly and professionally
Confirm appointments and keep customers updated
Ensure a high standard of communication across all touchpoints

3) Technician support & coordination
Work closely with technicians to keep jobs running smoothly
Assist with procurement, job preparation, and resolving issues
Provide clear job information, notes, and updates through Simpro
Escalate issues early and help keep projects moving

4) Systems & admin
Manage jobs and workflow primarily through Simpro
Maintain a controlled inbox and respond without delay
Use Office 365 (Outlook, Teams), SharePoint, and HubSpot CRM
Assist with invoice preparation and job close-out
Maintain clean and consistent job records and processes
Create, maintain, and improve SOPs and documented processes to support consistent workflow and operations

About you
Proven experience in scheduling or coordinating field staff (trade or service business highly regarded)
Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple jobs at once
Confident communicator with a focus on fast, clear responses
Comfortable working across multiple systems (Simpro experience highly regarded)
Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or CRM systems (e.g. HubSpot)
Proactive and able to work without constant direction
Based in Canberra and available to work from the office

Hours & flexibility
3 days per week (approximately 6 hours per day)
Designed to suit school hours
Initial in-person training, then a hybrid working arrangement
Flexible start and finish times within the middle of the day

Pay
$35-40 per hour + super, based on experience

Employer questions
Your application will include the following questions:
How many years' experience do you have as a service coordinator?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have experience using Xero?
Which of the following Microsoft Office products are you experienced with?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Police Check (National Police Certificate) for employment?
Do you own or have regular access to a car?

Job Description:
The Analyst Programmer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications that support business objectives. Key duties include writing and reviewing code, conducting software testing, and ensuring that application functionality meets specified requirements. The role also involves researching and designing technical solutions, as well as documenting and updating software specifications throughout the development lifecycle.
Responsibilities:
Demonstrate a strong understanding of coding methods, industry best practices, and software development standards.
Conduct interviews with end-users to gather insights into functionality, interface issues, usability, and challenges, ensuring user needs are effectively addressed.
Develop comprehensive test cases and test plans to ensure the reliability and performance of software applications.
Stay informed on data privacy laws and practices to ensure software development remains compliant.
Communicate clearly with non-technical staff and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Embrace new technologies and maintain a commitment to ongoing learning and skill development.
Display excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills to convey ideas and requirements effectively.
Conduct research into software-related challenges and assess potential solutions or products.
Demonstrate initiative, autonomy, and direction in executing work tasks and delivering projects.
Maintain strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision throughout the development process.
Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to resolve complex software-related issues.
Manage task prioritisation and execute effectively under pressure to meet project deadlines.
Collaborate closely with developers, programmers, and designers to conceptualise and develop innovative software solutions.
Evaluate existing business systems and processes to identify optimisation opportunities.
Assist in gathering, defining, and documenting business requirements, deliverables, and specifications in partnership with internal departments.
Contribute to software development project planning, including scope definition, scheduling, and implementation.
Engage with internal and external programme users to understand and fulfil functional requirements.
Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
At least 2 years of hands-on experience working as an Analyst Programmer or in a similar software development role.
Proficient in one or more programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, or JavaScript.
Strong understanding of database concepts and practical experience writing and optimising SQL queries.
Experience developing web applications using technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular, or ASP.NET.
Familiarity with modern software development methodologies, including Agile and Scrum frameworks.
Sound knowledge of software testing principles, with exposure to tools like JUnit or Selenium.
Experience using version control systems such as Git or SVN, and project tracking tools like JIRA or Trello.
Understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, along with their core services and deployment models.
Solid foundation in object-oriented programming (OOP) and commonly used software design patterns.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify and resolve complex coding issues.
Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to manage tasks, prioritise deliverables, and meet project deadlines.
Self-motivated with a commitment to ongoing learning and staying current with emerging tools and technologies.
Permanent Residents (PR) and Australian Citizens are eligible to apply
Job Types: Full-time, Permanent
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
Benefits: Work from home
Schedule: 8-hour shift

Key Responsibilities:

Financial Management
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards.
Develop and maintain comprehensive financial reporting systems for construction and property development projects.
Analyse financial performance and provide strategic recommendations to improve profitability and operational efficiency.
Monitor company cash flow and maintain adequate working capital for multiple concurrent construction projects.
Prepare management reports, financial dashboards, and performance analysis for executive decision-making.

Project Accounting
Monitor project budgets, construction expenditure, and development costs across residential and commercial projects.
Analyse project profitability, cost variances, and financial performance against approved budgets.
Prepare project feasibility analyses and financial forecasts for proposed developments.
Monitor work-in-progress, project revenue recognition, and construction contract accounting.
Assist management in evaluating investment opportunities and project financing requirements.

Budgeting and Forecasting
Prepare annual operating budgets and long-term financial forecasts.
Develop project-specific budgets and monitor financial performance throughout project lifecycles.
Conduct variance analysis and recommend corrective actions where required.
Support strategic business planning through financial modelling and scenario analysis.

Taxation and Regulatory Compliance
Prepare and review Business Activity Statements (BAS), GST, PAYG, payroll tax, Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT), and income tax information.
Ensure compliance with Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requirements and applicable taxation legislation.
Liaise with external tax advisers regarding taxation planning and compliance matters.
Ensure compliance with ASIC reporting obligations and other statutory requirements.
Maintain accurate accounting records in accordance with legislative and regulatory requirements.

Financial Controls and Risk Management
Develop and implement internal financial control systems and accounting policies.
Review financial procedures to improve efficiency and minimise financial risk.
Monitor company financial risks, including project funding, supplier obligations, and contractual commitments.
Assist in developing financial governance policies and risk management strategies.

Audit and Compliance
Coordinate external audits and provide supporting financial documentation.
Prepare reconciliations, supporting schedules, and audit working papers.
Implement recommendations arising from internal and external audits.
Ensure compliance with accounting standards, corporate governance requirements, and company policies.

Business Advisory
Provide financial advice to directors regarding property acquisitions, developments, renovations, and investment opportunities.
Analyse financing options for commercial and residential development projects.
Evaluate business performance indicators and recommend strategies to improve financial outcomes.
Assist management with pricing strategies, tender evaluations, and investment decisions.

Financial Systems
Maintain and improve accounting systems, financial software, and reporting processes.
Ensure the integrity and accuracy of financial information across all business operations.
Assist in implementing technology solutions that improve financial reporting and operational efficiency.

Stakeholder Management
Liaise with banks, financial institutions, external accountants, auditors, government agencies, suppliers, contractors, and project managers.
Prepare financial information required for loan applications, project funding, and investment proposals.
Support senior management with financial presentations and business reporting.

Essential Qualifications
Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Commerce, Finance, or a closely related discipline.
Strong knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards and taxation legislation.
Advanced analytical and financial reporting skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
High level of accuracy, professionalism, and attention to detail.

Desirable Experience
Experience within the property development, construction, building, or real estate industry.
Experience in project accounting and construction cost management.
Knowledge of Australian taxation requirements applicable to property development.
Experience using accounting software such as Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks, or similar enterprise accounting systems.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and financial modelling experience.

Key Competencies
Financial reporting and analysis.
Budget preparation and forecasting.
Project accounting and construction cost analysis.
Taxation compliance.
Financial planning and strategic advisory.
Internal controls and corporate governance.
Cash flow management.
Business and investment analysis.
Risk management.
Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.
Performance Outcomes
Accurate and timely financial reporting.
Effective project cost control and budget management.
Full compliance with taxation and statutory obligations.
Improved financial performance and profitability.
Strong financial governance and internal control systems.
Reliable financial advice supporting strategic business decisions.
Working Relationships

The General Accountant works collaboratively with:

Managing Director
Project Managers
Site Supervisors
Contract Administrators
Estimators
External Accountants
Auditors
Tax Advisers
Banks and Financial Institutions
Australian Taxation Office (ATO)
Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC)
Professional Responsibility

The Accountant is expected to maintain confidentiality, comply with all relevant accounting and taxation legislation, uphold ethical professional standards, and contribute to the ongoing financial success and sustainable growth of Maximus Property Holdings Pty Ltd trading as Upbuild Property Solutions.

Salary: $82,000/Annum

•	Reliable, self-motivated, and capable of working independently and within a team.

Target Business Services

Position:		Full Time – Permanent
Location: 		South Hurstville, NSW 2221
Salary: 			$80,000 - $85,000 plus 12% Superannuation

Spark Easy Electrical Pty Ltd is a Sydney-based business specialising in solar panel installation, ducted air conditioning installation, and roof installation and restoration. The company is seeking an experienced Roof Tiler to support its roofing operations by installing, repairing and maintaining tiled roofing systems while ensuring high standards of workmanship and workplace safety. 

The successful applicant will be responsible for installing, repairing and maintaining tiled roofing systems while ensuring all work complies with Australian building standards and workplace safety requirements. This role is essential to maintaining the company's reputation for delivering high-quality roofing solutions and exceptional customer service. 

Minimum Requirements

-	Certificate III in Roof Tiling or an equivalent AQF qualification. 
-	At least two years of relevant full-time experience as a Roof Tiler. 
-	Demonstrated experience installing, repairing and restoring tiled roofs. 
-	Ability to safely work at heights and interpret roofing plans and specifications. 
-	Current White Card and a valid driver's licence. 

What you will be responsible for

-	Studying drawings, specifications and work sites to determine roofing materials and installation methods. 
-	Erecting ladders, scaffolding and fall-protection equipment in accordance with workplace safety requirements. 
-	Installing roofing underlay and securing waterproof sheets over eaves to protect roof structures. 
-	Aligning and fixing starter rows of roof tiles and laying successive rows to achieve correct alignment and weatherproof performance. 
-	Measuring, marking and cutting roof tiles to fit accurately around chimneys, valleys, skylights, vents, ridges and roof penetrations. 
-	Installing ridge and edge tiles using appropriate bedding mortar and pointing materials. 
-	Installing flashing and sealing roof penetrations to prevent water ingress. 
-	Inspecting roofs to identify damaged or defective tiles and carrying out repair and restoration work where required. 
-	Re-roofing existing buildings by removing damaged roofing materials and installing new tiled roofing systems. 
-	Applying sealants and flashing exposed nail heads and roof junctions to ensure long-term waterproofing. 
-	Maintaining roofing tools, equipment and materials in a safe and serviceable condition. 
-	Working collaboratively with supervisors and other construction trades to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and to specification. 
-	Ensuring all roofing work complies with Australian Standards, building regulations and workplace health and safety requirements. 

Skills, Experience and Attributes

-	Strong knowledge of roof tiling systems, roofing materials and installation techniques. 
-	Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications. 
-	Excellent attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality workmanship. 
-	Strong problem-solving and organisational skills. 
-	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
-	Physically fit and capable of working safely at heights. 
-	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements. 

The Successful Applicant

You will be required to work on residential and commercial roofing projects across Sydney. The position involves working outdoors in varying weather conditions, meeting project deadlines and maintaining high standards of workmanship and safety. You must demonstrate reliability, a strong work ethic, and the ability to communicate effectively with supervisors, clients and fellow tradespeople.

Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and all applications will be treated as strictly confidential.

To apply for this position, email your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au.

Our client Evergreen Organic Wholesaler Pty Ptd trading as Evergreen Organic has grown rapidly as a trusted supplier of premium organic produce at Sydney Markets. Built on strong grower relationships and a team with deep industry experience, Evergreen Organic serves most of Sydney’s leading organic businesses and customers across Australia — prioritizing organic integrity, traceability and consistent quality. 

Evergreen Organic is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to lead food-safety, product quality and supplier compliance across market and warehouse operations. This is a managerial role with accountability for the company’s quality systems, organic certification integrity, supplier assurance, audit readiness and continuous improvement — a hands-on position with frequent supplier engagement at Sydney Markets.

Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

-	Relevant bachelor degree or equivalent qualification.
-	Minimum 1 year experience in quality assurance, food safety or quality management; experience in fresh produce, horticulture or perishable foods (especially organic) highly desirable.
-	Practical HACCP experience and proven track record managing food-safety systems and third-party audits.
-	Demonstrated experience with supplier audits, traceability, specification compliance and corrective action processes.
-	Familiarity with organic certification requirements (SXC and other relevant standards) and a practical understanding of maintaining organic integrity through the supply chain.
-	Experience using QA/ERP/CRM tools and strong Excel skills for KPI reporting.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

-	Own and maintain the company’s food-safety and quality management systems (HACCP/Food Safety Plan, QA documentation, traceability and recall procedures).
-	Lead and manage internal QA activity and coordinate all external audits/certifications (including SXC and other third-party standards such as Freshcare/HARPS where applicable).
-	Manage the supplier assurance program for organic produce — verify supplier organic certification, oversee onboarding, specification compliance, grower agreements and corrective actions.
-	Maintain organic integrity across the supply chain
-	Operate and continuously improve traceability systems and recall readiness; lead communications and corrective action for product quality incidents.
-	Perform product inspections, sampling and testing; lead non-conformance investigations, root-cause analysis and CAPA implementation.
-	Develop, monitor and present quality KPIs (rejects, complaints, supplier performance, cold-chain metrics) and provide actionable insights to management.
-	Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Customer Service to protect cold-chain integrity and ensure product specification adherence for specialty and seasonal ranges.
-	Manage QA documentation, SOP version control and compliance recordkeeping to support audits and regulatory requirements.
-	Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce waste, improve yield and enhance customer satisfaction.

Skills Requirements:

-	Strong attention to detail, excellent observational skills and a methodical investigative approach.
-	Confident communicator able to engage growers, suppliers and operational teams.
-	Proven ability to lead training, change management and continuous improvement initiatives.
-	Sound knowledge of food safety legislation and regulatory requirements (FSANZ/state health regulators) is an advantage.
-	Results-focused, with the ability to balance hands-on QA work and managerial oversight.

If you are a proactive and results-driven professional, we encourage you to apply!

About the Role
On behalf of our client – a specialist 4WD and off-road workshop that stocks parts for virtually every make and model – we are seeking an experienced Motor Mechanic (General). This role focuses on diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining a wide range of vehicles, with a strong emphasis on 4WD systems, heavy-duty suspension, driveline components, and engine performance. You will work in a well-equipped shop that handles everything from routine servicing to complex mechanical and electrical fault-finding on modern and classic 4x4s.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
• Detect and diagnose mechanical and electrical faults in engines, transmissions, steering, and 4WD-specific systems (e.g., transfer cases, differentials, locking hubs) using diagnostic computers and manual test equipment.
• Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms, and suspension components; inspect parts for wear or damage and refer to service manuals to determine repair or replacement needs.
• Repair or replace worn or defective parts – including clutches, brakes, CV joints, and turbochargers – and reassemble mechanical components to manufacturer specifications.
• Perform scheduled maintenance such as oil changes, filter replacements, lubrications, and engine tune-ups to ensure smooth running and compliance with emission regulations.
• Test and adjust repaired mechanical parts (e.g., wheel alignment, brake balance, engine timing) to verify proper performance and safety.
• Inspect vehicles for roadworthiness, issue certificates, or detail required repairs; may respond to breakdown calls for on-site assistance.

Requirements
• Trade qualification as a Motor Mechanic (General) or equivalent experience.
• Proven 1-year full-time experience in diagnostic skills with both conventional and computerized systems, especially on 4WD and light commercial vehicles.
• Ability to interpret service manuals, wiring diagrams, and parts catalogues accurately.
• Strong attention to detail, physical stamina, and a valid driver’s license (manual license preferred).
• Commitment to safety and quality workmanship.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

Apply now to join a team that works on all vehicles – from daily drivers to serious off-road rigs.
